pure-announcement.rationale: The note is a raw PDF byte dump of Thompson's 1984 Turing lecture, not an announcement of anything.

duplicate.rationale: No legible content overlaps any neighbour, and the underlying trusting-trust paper has no counterpart concept in the corpus.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The linked source is Thompson's published 1984 ACM lecture, a primary and checkable document; the note's defect is failed extraction, not unverifiable claims.

durability.rationale: The staged note contains only unparsed PDF binary streams (%PDF-1.3 headers, FlateDecode objects), so there is no legible content in it to remain true or useful.

actionability.rationale: Nothing in the note can be read, so nothing in it can change how anyone builds or decides.

atomicity.rationale: No core idea can be stated from the note at all, since its body is 361KB of binary garbage rather than prose.
